# Cryp2bus (Cryptobus)

> Educational explainers on business crypto settlements, invoice payments, treasury, and compliance. Cryp2bus is operated by TELEPORT FINANCIAL SERVICES s.r.o. (VASP, Czech Republic, IČO 21369909) under a white-label agreement with VS Digital Europe Ltd., a crypto-asset service provider authorised under MiCA by the Malta Financial Services Authority (LEI 984500G55775959B9C37). Cryp2bus provides crypto transaction infrastructure for businesses — not investment advice.

Site: https://cryp2bus.com/
Blog: https://cryp2bus.com/blog/
